name: Newton's Law of Viscosity
description: Shear stress between two adjacent layers of fluid is directly proportional to the negative value of the velocity gradient.

name: Shear Stress
description: Shear stress is the shearing force per unit area.

name: Viscosity
description: The ratio of shearing stress to the velocity gradient.

name: Capillary action (Capillarity)
description: Height which the liquid can be lifted in a narrow tube.

name: Surface tension
description: The force per unit length that acts across any line on a surface.

name: Stokes' law
description: The drag force F acting upward in resistance to the fall of a spherical object in a viscous liquid.
